verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ πέντε ἡμέρας κατέβη ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς Ἁνανίας μετὰ πρεσβυτέρων τινῶν καὶ ῥήτορος Τερτύλλου τινός οἵτινες ἐνεφάνισαν τῷ ἡγεμόνι κατὰ τοῦ Παύλου
verses.transliteration: Meta de pente hēmeras katebē ho archiereus Hananias meta presbyterōn tinōn kai rhētoros Tertyllou tinos hoitines enephanisan tō hēgemoni kata tou Paulou
verses.literal: Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus who presented to the governor their case against Paul
verses.literalPt: E, CINCO dias depois, o sumo sacerdote Ananias desceu com os anciãos, e um certo Tértulo, orador, os quais compareceram perante o presidente contra Paulo.

verses.original: Κληθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἤρξατο κατηγορεῖν ὁ Τέρτυλλος λέγων Πολλῆς εἰρήνης τυγχάνοντες διὰ σοῦ καὶ διορθωμάτων γινομένων τῷ ἔθνει τούτῳ διὰ τῆς σῆς προνοίας
verses.transliteration: Klēthentos de autou ērxato katēgorein ho Tertyllos legōn Pollēs eirēnēs tynchanontes dia sou kai diorthōmatōn ginomenōn tō ethnei toutō dia tēs sēs pronoias
verses.literal: When Paul had been called in Tertullus opened the prosecution Because of you we have enjoyed a lasting peace and - your foresight has brought improvements to this nation
verses.literalPt: E, sendo chamado, Tértulo começou a acusá-lo, dizendo: Visto como por ti temos tanta paz e por tua prudência se fazem a este povo muitos e louváveis serviços,

verses.original: πάντῃ τε καὶ πανταχοῦ ἀποδεχόμεθα κράτιστε Φῆλιξ μετὰ πάσης εὐχαριστίας
verses.transliteration: pantē te kai pantachou apodechometha kratiste Phēlix meta pasēs eucharistias
verses.literal: In every way and everywhere most excellent Felix we acknowledge this with all gratitude
verses.literalPt: Sempre e em todo o lugar, ó potentíssimo Félix, com todo o agradecimento o queremos reconhecer.

verses.original: ἵνα δὲ μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖόν σε ἐνκόπτω παρακαλῶ ἀκοῦσαί σε ἡμῶν συντόμως τῇ σῇ ἐπιεικείᾳ
verses.transliteration: hina de mē epi pleion se enkoptō parakalō akousai se hēmōn syntomōs tē sē epieikeia
verses.literal: But in order not to delay you any further I beg - your indulgence to hear us briefly
verses.literalPt: Mas, para que não te detenha muito, rogo-te que, conforme a tua eqüidade, nos ouças por pouco tempo.

verses.original: Εὑρόντες γὰρ τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον λοιμὸν καὶ κινοῦντα στάσεις πᾶσιν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τοῖς κατὰ τὴν οἰκουμένην πρωτοστάτην τε τῆς τῶν Ναζωραίων αἱρέσεως
verses.transliteration: Heurontes gar ton andra touton loimon kai kinounta staseis pasin tois Ioudaiois tois kata tēn oikoumenēn prōtostatēn te tēs tōn Nazōraiōn haireseōs
verses.literal: We have found this man to be a pestilence stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes
verses.literalPt: Temos achado que este homem é uma peste, e promotor de sedições entre todos os judeus, por todo o mundo; e o principal defensor da seita dos nazarenos;

verses.original: ὃς καὶ τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπείρασεν βεβηλῶσαι ὃν καὶ ἐκρατήσαμεν
verses.transliteration: hos kai to hieron epeirasen bebēlōsai hon kai ekratēsamen
verses.literal: and he even tried to desecrate the temple so we seized him
verses.literalPt: O qual intentou também profanar o templo; e nós o prendemos, e conforme a nossa lei o quisemos julgar.
Mas, sobrevindo o tribuno Lísias, no-lo tirou de entre as mãos com grande violência,

verses.original: παρ’ οὗ δυνήσῃ αὐτὸς ἀνακρίνας περὶ πάντων τούτων ἐπιγνῶναι ὧν ἡμεῖς κατηγοροῦμεν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: par’ hou dynēsē autos anakrinas peri pantōn toutōn epignōnai hōn hēmeis katēgoroumen autou
verses.literal: By examining him yourself you will be able to learn the truth about all . . . our charges against him
verses.literalPt: Mandando aos seus acusadores que viessem a ti; e dele tu mesmo, examinando-o, poderás entender tudo o de que o acusamos.

verses.original: Συνεπέθεντο δὲ καὶ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι φάσκοντες ταῦτα οὕτως ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: Synepethento de kai hoi Ioudaioi phaskontes tauta houtōs echein
verses.literal: The Jews concurred asserting that these charges were true
verses.literalPt: E também os judeus o acusavam, dizendo serem estas coisas assim.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη τε ὁ Παῦλος νεύσαντος αὐτῷ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος λέγειν Ἐκ πολλῶν ἐτῶν ὄντα σε κριτὴν τῷ ἔθνει τούτῳ ἐπιστάμενος εὐθύμως τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ ἀπολογοῦμαι
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē te ho Paulos neusantos autō tou hēgemonos legein Ek pollōn etōn onta se kritēn tō ethnei toutō epistamenos euthymōs ta peri emautou apologoumai
verses.literal: When the governor motioned for Paul to speak he began his response Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years I gladly make my defense . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Paulo, porém, fazendo-lhe o presidente sinal que falasse, respondeu: Porque sei que já vai para muitos anos que desta nação és juiz, com tanto melhor ânimo respondo por mim.

verses.original: δυναμένου σου ἐπιγνῶναι ὅτι οὐ πλείους εἰσίν μοι ἡμέραι δώδεκα ἀφ’ ἧς ἀνέβην προσκυνήσων εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: dynamenou sou epignōnai hoti ou pleious eisin moi hēmerai dōdeka aph’ hēs anebēn proskynēsōn eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: You can verify for yourself that no - more than twelve days ago . . . I went up to Jerusalem to worship
verses.literalPt: Pois bem podes saber que não há mais de doze dias que subi a Jerusalém a adorar;

verses.original: καὶ οὔτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὗρόν με πρός τινα διαλεγόμενον ἢ ἐπίστασιν ποιοῦντα ὄχλου οὔτε ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς οὔτε κατὰ τὴν πόλιν
verses.transliteration: kai oute en tō hierō heuron me pros tina dialegomenon ē epistasin poiounta ochlou oute en tais synagōgais oute kata tēn polin
verses.literal: Yet my accusers did not find me debating with anyone in the temple or riling up . . . a crowd in the synagogues or in the city
verses.literalPt: E não me acharam no templo falando com alguém, nem amotinando o povo nas sinagogas, nem na cidade.

verses.original: οὐδὲ παραστῆσαι δύνανταί σοι περὶ ὧν νυνὶ κατηγοροῦσίν μου
verses.transliteration: oude parastēsai dynantai soi peri hōn nyni katēgorousin mou
verses.literal: Nor can they prove to you any of their charges against me
verses.literalPt: Nem tampouco podem provar as coisas de que agora me acusam.

verses.original: Ὁμολογῶ δὲ τοῦτό σοι ὅτι κατὰ τὴν Ὁδὸν ἣν λέγουσιν αἵρεσιν οὕτως λατρεύω τῷ πατρῴῳ Θεῷ πιστεύων πᾶσι τοῖς κατὰ τὸν νόμον καὶ τοῖς ἐν τοῖς προφήταις γεγραμμένοις
verses.transliteration: Homologō de touto soi hoti kata tēn Hodon hēn legousin hairesin houtōs latreuō tō patrōō Theō pisteuōn pasi tois kata ton nomon kai tois en tois prophētais gegrammenois
verses.literal: I do confess to you however that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way which they call a sect I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets
verses.literalPt: Mas confesso-te isto que, conforme aquele caminho que chamam seita, assim sirvo ao Deus de nossos pais, crendo tudo quanto está escrito na lei e nos profetas.

verses.original: ἐλπίδα ἔχων εἰς τὸν Θεόν ἣν καὶ αὐτοὶ οὗτοι προσδέχονται ἀνάστασιν μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι δικαίων τε καὶ ἀδίκων
verses.transliteration: elpida echōn eis ton Theon hēn kai autoi houtoi prosdechontai anastasin mellein esesthai dikaiōn te kai adikōn
verses.literal: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked
verses.literalPt: Tendo esperança em Deus, como estes mesmos também esperam, de que há de haver ressurreição de mortos, assim dos justos como dos injustos.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ καὶ αὐτὸς ἀσκῶ ἀπρόσκοπον συνείδησιν ἔχειν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν καὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους διὰ παντός
verses.transliteration: en toutō kai autos askō aproskopon syneidēsin echein pros ton Theon kai tous anthrōpous dia pantos
verses.literal: In this hope I strive always . . . to maintain a clear conscience before God and man
verses.literalPt: E por isso procuro sempre ter uma consciência sem ofensa, tanto para com Deus como para com os homens.

verses.original: Δι’ ἐτῶν δὲ πλειόνων ἐλεημοσύνας ποιήσων εἰς τὸ ἔθνος μου παρεγενόμην καὶ προσφοράς
verses.transliteration: Di’ etōn de pleionōn eleēmosynas poiēsōn eis to ethnos mou paregenomēn kai prosphoras
verses.literal: After several years then I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings
verses.literalPt: Ora, muitos anos depois, vim trazer à minha nação esmolas e ofertas.

verses.original: ἐν αἷς εὗρόν με ἡγνισμένον ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐ μετὰ ὄχλου οὐδὲ μετὰ θορύβου τινὲς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἀσίας Ἰουδαῖοι
verses.transliteration: en hais heuron me hēgnismenon en tō hierō ou meta ochlou oude meta thorybou tines de apo tēs Asias Ioudaioi
verses.literal: At the time they found me in the temple I was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar But there are some Jews from the province of Asia
verses.literalPt: Nisto me acharam já santificado no templo, não em ajuntamentos, nem com alvoroços, uns certos judeus da Ásia,

verses.original: οὓς ἔδει ἐπὶ σοῦ παρεῖναι καὶ κατηγορεῖν εἴ τι ἔχοιεν πρὸς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: hous edei epi sou pareinai kai katēgorein ei ti echoien pros eme
verses.literal: who ought to appear before you and bring charges if they have anything against me
verses.literalPt: Os quais convinha que estivessem presentes perante ti, e me acusassem, se alguma coisa contra mim tivessem.

verses.original: ἢ αὐτοὶ οὗτοι εἰπάτωσαν τί εὗρον ἀδίκημα στάντος μου ἐπὶ τοῦ συνεδρίου
verses.transliteration: ē autoi houtoi eipatōsan ti heuron adikēma stantos mou epi tou synedriou
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . let these men state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin
verses.literalPt: Ou digam estes mesmos, se acharam em mim alguma iniqüidade, quando compareci perante o conselho,

verses.original: ἢ περὶ μιᾶς ταύτης φωνῆς ἧς ἐκέκραξα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἑστὼς ὅτι Περὶ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν ἐγὼ κρίνομαι σήμερον ἐφ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ē peri mias tautēs phōnēs hēs ekekraxa en autois hestōs hoti Peri anastaseōs nekrōn egō krinomai sēmeron eph’ hymōn
verses.literal: unless it was . . . this one thing I called out as I stood in their presence It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today
verses.literalPt: A não ser estas palavras que, estando entre eles, clamei: Hoje sou julgado por vós acerca da ressurreição dos mortos.

verses.original: Ἀνεβάλετο δὲ αὐτοὺς ὁ Φῆλιξ ἀκριβέστερον εἰδὼς τὰ περὶ τῆς Ὁδοῦ εἴπας Ὅταν Λυσίας ὁ χιλίαρχος καταβῇ διαγνώσομαι τὰ καθ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Anebaleto de autous ho Phēlix akribesteron eidōs ta peri tēs Hodou eipas Hotan Lysias ho chiliarchos katabē diagnōsomai ta kath’ hymas
verses.literal: Then Felix who was well informed about the Way adjourned the hearing . . . and said When Lysias the commander comes I will decide your case
verses.literalPt: Então Félix, havendo ouvido estas coisas, lhes pôs dilação, dizendo: Havendo-me informado melhor deste Caminho, quando o tribuno Lísias tiver descido, então tomarei inteiro conhecimento dos vossos negócios.

verses.original: διαταξάμενος τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ τηρεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ἔχειν τε ἄνεσιν καὶ μηδένα κωλύειν τῶν ἰδίων αὐτοῦ ὑπηρετεῖν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: diataxamenos tō hekatontarchē tēreisthai auton echein te anesin kai mēdena kōlyein tōn idiōn autou hypēretein autō
verses.literal: He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard . . . but to allow him some freedom and permit his friends to minister to his needs
verses.literalPt: E mandou ao centurião que o guardasse em prisão, tratando-o com brandura, e que a ninguém dos seus proibisse servi-lo ou vir ter com ele.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ἡμέρας τινὰς παραγενόμενος ὁ Φῆλιξ σὺν Δρουσίλλῃ τῇ ἰδίᾳ γυναικὶ οὔσῃ Ἰουδαίᾳ μετεπέμψατο τὸν Παῦλον καὶ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ περὶ τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Meta de hēmeras tinas paragenomenos ho Phēlix syn Drousillē tē idia gynaiki ousē Ioudaia metepempsato ton Paulon kai ēkousen autou peri tēs eis Christon Iēsoun pisteōs
verses.literal: After several days Felix returned with his wife Drusilla who was a Jewess He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: E alguns dias depois, vindo Félix com sua mulher Drusila, que era judia, mandou chamar a Paulo, e ouviu-o acerca da fé em Cristo.

verses.original: διαλεγομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐγκρατείας καὶ τοῦ κρίματος τοῦ μέλλοντος ἔμφοβος γενόμενος ὁ Φῆλιξ ἀπεκρίθη Τὸ νῦν ἔχον πορεύου καιρὸν δὲ μεταλαβὼν μετακαλέσομαί σε
verses.transliteration: dialegomenou de autou peri dikaiosynēs kai enkrateias kai tou krimatos tou mellontos emphobos genomenos ho Phēlix apekrithē To nyn echon poreuou kairon de metalabōn metakalesomai se
verses.literal: As Paul expounded on righteousness self-control and the coming judgment Felix became frightened and said You may go . . . for now When I find the time I will call for you
verses.literalPt: E, tratando ele da justiça, e da temperança, e do juízo vindouro, Félix, espavorido, respondeu: Por agora vai-te, e em tendo oportunidade te chamarei.

verses.original: ἅμα καὶ ἐλπίζων ὅτι χρήματα δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου διὸ καὶ πυκνότερον αὐτὸν μεταπεμπόμενος ὡμίλει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hama kai elpizōn hoti chrēmata dothēsetai autō hypo tou Paulou dio kai pyknoteron auton metapempomenos hōmilei autō
verses.literal: At the same time . . . he was hoping that - Paul would offer him a bribe So he sent for Paul frequently and talked with him
verses.literalPt: Esperando ao mesmo tempo que Paulo lhe desse dinheiro, para que o soltasse; pelo que também muitas vezes o mandava chamar, e falava com ele.

verses.original: Διετίας δὲ πληρωθείσης ἔλαβεν διάδοχον ὁ Φῆλιξ Πόρκιον Φῆστον θέλων τε χάριτα καταθέσθαι τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὁ Φῆλιξ κατέλιπε τὸν Παῦλον δεδεμένον
verses.transliteration: Dietias de plērōtheisēs elaben diadochon ho Phēlix Porkion Phēston thelōn te charita katathesthai tois Ioudaiois ho Phēlix katelipe ton Paulon dedemenon
verses.literal: After two years had passed Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus And wishing to do the Jews a favor . . . . . . . . . Felix left Paul in prison
verses.literalPt: Mas, passados dois anos, Félix teve por sucessor a Pórcio Festo; e, querendo Félix comprazer aos judeus, deixou a Paulo preso.
